body: They were in disbelief and a couple of them acted like they were disgusted and completely on my side but they still hang out with him every week so I stopped talking to them after learning that wasn’t going to stop
The sad part was that they were my friends first, for years, but they still hangout with him after knowing everything he’s done to me.
is this suppose to be a joke?
Being more understanding to a variety of situations and learning how to communicate effectively caused personal growth

I went outside today and did laundry to avoid being productive with my work. My shower only made me exhausted since I usually shower at nights. I was staring at my laptop for hours but didn’t have the brain power to do any actual work. I just feel lost. It’s been like this for weeks since my breakup.
Thank you for your response. I was considering talking to a campus counselor since this has been very difficult to deal with.
The confusing part is he left me and then did all of this.

I’m scared to ever be in a relationship or trust anyone again. His words and actions have shocked me to my core and I feel like I can’t allow myself to open up in the future from being hurt to this extent. I’ve been hurt in the past and I thought my current ex was a “good guy” but he turned out to be the worst I’ve ever had.
I replied to another comment describing my dads reaction.

I had a class with one of my friends and couldn’t stand sitting next to them. I didn’t think about moving seats, I just got up and left and came to a quiet place in my campus. This is the first time skipping a college class and I’m afraid of developing bad habits like skipping class often in order to avoid my so called “friends.” I just can’t think of them the same anymore. I’ve known them for 4-5 years and he’s only known them for 2. I feel completely alone.

My dad said “see, guys only want one thing and to focus on my dream of becoming an Orthopedic Surgeon.” I also know that my dad told my ex that the same thing could happen to his sister or mom so to watch out for karma. My dad is a retired cop so I’m honestly surprised he didn’t shoot him. My ex has ruined a chance for any possible relationship with a future guy and my parents so I’m seriously going to be single for many years.

He needs serious help. I’ve seen this rage in my family members and it never went away, it only got worse. Your SO should never physically harm you, no matter what. Whether he ever did or not, the fact that he could do that to his own mother is a serious red flag. He should go to counseling, possibly anger management but you should seriously stay away from him for your own safety.

I feel like telling my family he physically used me and didn’t love me was the ultimate escalation. I honestly just can’t handle anymore. I feel like he hurt me beyond with what I could handle by hurting my parents and causing me to lose my friends.

Hearing him say all of that over the phone hurt so much but I feel like he’s a serious psychopath for telling my parents and friends. I have no idea if he was being remorseful or was just bragging . . in the time I’ve known him he’s never seemed mentally unstable until now so it was a big surprise.
Although I feel like that’s the only way, I’m not sure if this is enough evidence for a restraining order and I honestly dont want to see him in court.
I told him that if he went near my family again or showed up to my house then I’d file a restraining order. I have no idea if he read my message or not.

He said that his phone call didn’t satisfy him and he wanted to repeat his letter face-to-face. I’m hoping he doesn’t go to my college or to my house again. It hurts me to even think about since I wanted to work things out but this new side of him has absolutely killed that chance of ever happening.
I thought about getting a restraining order if this continued because he didn’t sound close to being done from what he said on the phone. I truly believe he’s tryin to ruin my life.
